facts.text: The hotel is at 9850 Wilshire Blvd in Beverly Hills.
facts.excerpt: 9850 Wilshire Blvd

facts.text: Rooms are styled by interior designer Pierre-Yves Rochon.
facts.excerpt: Luxuriously styled by interior design legend Pierre-Yves Rochon, our oversized rooms feature state-of-the-art technology, luxurious finishes and floor-to-ceiling windows.

facts.text: Rooms and suites have floor-to-ceiling windows and terraces with views of Beverly Hills and the Santa Monica Mountains.
facts.excerpt: designed to showcase sweeping views of Beverly Hills and the Santa Monica Mountains, each with floor-to-ceiling windows and oversized terraces

facts.text: Baldi is a Tuscan steakhouse led by Chef Edoardo 'Edo' Baldi, built on family recipes.
facts.excerpt: the restaurant is led by Chef Edoardo “Edo” Baldi, Tuscan-born and L.A.-raised

facts.text: At Baldi, steaks are cooked over an olive wood-fired grill, alongside house-made pastas.
facts.excerpt: cooked over an olive wood–fired grill using little more than fire, time, and restraint. Beyond the grill, the menu includes house made pastas

facts.text: Bar Baldi's wine cellar emphasizes Italian regions, particularly Piedmont and Tuscany.
facts.excerpt: showcasing a deep selection with a strong emphasis on Italy’s most celebrated regions, particularly Piedmont and Tuscany

facts.text: Gemma is a Pan-Asian rooftop restaurant 12 stories above the city, with views of the Santa Monica Mountains and Beverly Hills.
facts.excerpt: Perched 12 stories above the city of Los Angeles.

facts.text: Gemma's menu includes dim sum, a 'from the wok' menu, sushi and grilled steaks including Japanese Wagyu.
facts.excerpt: signature dishes that include delicate dim sum, an extensive ‘from the wok’ menu, a selection of pristine sushi, and premium grilled steaks – including Japanese Wagyu

facts.text: Gemma's bar serves tiki-inspired cocktails such as a Scorpion bowl, Mai Tai and Pina colada, plus a list of sakes.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in a Scorpion bowl, Mai Tai, or Piña colada from our tiki-inspired creations

facts.text: Gemma was created by Chef Peleg Miron with the hotel's chefs.
facts.excerpt: Chef Peleg Miron and the award-winning chefs of Waldorf Astoria Beverly Hills created Gemma.

facts.text: In-room dining is available 24 hours a day, ordered from an in-room tablet.
facts.excerpt: Available 24 hours a day. Restaurant-quality meals are a tap away on your in-room tablet.

facts.text: The hotel has a La Prairie Spa.
facts.excerpt: Retreat to a world of bliss and rejuvenation at our La Prairie Spa.

facts.text: The La Prairie Spa has six treatment rooms.
facts.excerpt: the world-class La Prairie Spa has six treatment rooms

facts.text: The hotel has a rooftop pool.
facts.excerpt: bask in the allure of Beverly Hills' most glamorous rooftop pool

facts.text: From the rooftop pool, on a clear day you can see all the way to downtown.
facts.excerpt: On a clear day, you can see all the way to downtown.

facts.text: Salon de Lucy, inside the hotel, offers haircuts, color, styling, makeup and men's grooming, and has been part of the hotel since its opening.
facts.excerpt: our salon has been part of the hotel since its opening, with Lucy herself styling here from the very beginning

facts.text: Director of Wellness Tom McKiver, a registered nutritionist, leads personal training and nutrition programs.
facts.excerpt: Tom is a seasoned wellness professional and registered nutritionist

facts.text: Guests must be 16 or older to use the fitness center equipment.
facts.excerpt: Guests must be 16 years of age or older to use the fitness center.

facts.text: Signature Suite bookings include private car service to and from LAX or Burbank airport, an in-suite bar cart, custom Diptyque scent, monogrammed sheets and a session with the Director of Wellness.
facts.excerpt: Private car service to and from LAX or BUR airport

facts.text: The Suite Ride offer gives suite guests access to a luxury vehicle such as a Rolls-Royce Cullinan or Bentley Bentayga.
facts.excerpt: enjoy access to a luxury vehicle tailored to your suite choice, including a Rolls-Royce Cullinan and Bentley Bentayga

facts.text: The Presidential Suite is on the penthouse floor with a private terrace, a mini-gym and a home theater.
facts.excerpt: A secluded mini-gym offers your own private workout station and entertain guests in your personal home theater.

facts.text: Villa Suites have a 360-degree view from the terrace, a private dining room and a private dressing room.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy the 360-degree view from your spacious terrace. Each suite features a king-sized bed and a private dining room, private dressing room, separate powder room, and walk-in closets.

facts.text: The lobby is Art Deco-inspired, with triple-height ceilings and two large chandeliers.
facts.excerpt: aside from the triple-height ceilings, floors polished to a sheen, celadon wing-back chairs, and two show-stopping chandeliers

facts.text: There is a Bijan boutique in the lobby.
facts.excerpt:
Bijan
boutique in the lobby

facts.text: The hotel is pet-friendly; dogs get a dog bed, bowls and treats.
facts.excerpt: The hotel is exceptionally pet-friendly

facts.text: Check-in is at 4 pm and check-out at 11 am.
facts.excerpt: Check-in **4:00 PM**

facts.text: Bathrooms are in white and off-white marble with gold accents and separate tubs and showers.
facts.excerpt: spacious, gleaming white/off-white marble and gold accents, and separate tubs and showers

facts.text: iPads in the rooms control the lighting and draperies.
facts.excerpt: iPads control everything from the lighting and draperies to the remote control

facts.text: Rodeo Drive is among the nearby destinations the hotel highlights.
facts.excerpt: Rodeo Drive is one of the world’s most luxurious destinations for fashion and entertainment.

facts.text: The smallest room is 630 square feet.
facts.excerpt: The smallest room is 630 square feet

facts.text: Deluxe King Room with Terrace is 537 sq. ft.
facts.excerpt: 537 sq. ft.

facts.text: Condé Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Awards 2017-2025 listed.
The hotel calls its rooftop pool Beverly Hills' most glamorous.
facts.excerpt: Beverly Hills' most glamorous rooftop pool

contradictions.note: Condé Nast Traveler says the smallest room is 630 sq ft; the official rooms page lists Deluxe King rooms at 537 sq ft
